title: A CLICK ON A GUN KEY STILL WORKS
why: A slip in the guns-on-keys-1-to-4 build: it refused every drop of a gun on a key past the fourth, including the press and release on the key the gun came from, which is a click. A gun still bound to such a key (a saved plan from before the change) could not be clicked up. A click on the key it came from brings the gun up again, and a drag of it onto another key past the gun keys is still refused.
now: A click on a gun bound past key 4 brings it up again; dragging it to another such key stays refused.

edits.replacement: if(_dit&&_dit.use==='gun'&&HC.i>=GUNKEYS&&d.fromHot!==HC.i){   // v25.xx (belt2b): a press and release on the key it came from is a click, and a click still brings the gun up (v18.90)
